test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct chronological arrangement of Pandit Birju Maharaj’s achievements for his contributions to Indian dance:

(A) He received National Film Award for Best Choreography for the film Vishwaroopam.

(B) He received Padma Vibhushan for his dedication towards Indian dance.

(C) He received Filmfare Award for Best Choreography for the film Bajirao Mastani.
solution:
The correct answer is __**(B), (A), (C)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Pandit Birju Maharaj:-

 
 
• He was a renowned Indian Kathak dancer, composer, singer, and artist.
 
• He was a leading exponent of the Lucknow Kalka-Bindadin Gharana of Kathak dance in India.
 
• Birju Maharaj made several important contributions to the field of Kathak dance.
 
• He refined the technique and style of the dance, and he helped to popularize Kathak dance to a wider audience.
 
• He also choreographed several dance dramas that used Kathak dance as a form of storytelling.
 
 
 
• Birju Maharaj was honored with several awards:
 
 
• **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award (1964)**: One of India's highest honors for performing artists, awarded by the National Academy for Music, Dance, and Drama, recognizing his excellence in Kathak dance.
 
• **Padma Bhushan (1986):** India's third-highest civilian award, granted for distinguished service, acknowledging his remarkable contributions to classical dance and the global promotion of Kathak.
 
• **Padma Vibhushan (2016):** The second-highest civilian award in India, given for exceptional service, celebrating his outstanding influence and leadership in Indian classical dance.
